title: Luxury Outdoor Kitchen Featuring Twin Eagles Eagle One Grill & True Residential Refrigeration
description: Amazing custom outdoor kitchen featuring all top of the line luxury brands such as @twineaglesgrills @trueresidential @fornoclassico & @bromic_heating. Fully functional with double drawer refrigerator, double drawer freezer, filtered ice maker, glass door refrigerator, 54” gas grill, 24” power burner & Hybrid Gas/Wood Masonry Pizza Oven. Plenty of counter space & plenty of equipment for the chefs to work their magic ✨🤩😍
